journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: Presidential Lecture 2025: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
articles.title_cn: 主席演讲 2025：元素周期表的过度特权？绿色转型的地缘经济、内生中心性与战略矿产
articles.abstract_en: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for 13 electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the more diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance, an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this logic in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality can map into pricing power: the response of the world price of critical minerals to a supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated, the downstream demand and the competitive fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise consumer inflation in the European Union and the United States by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely a descriptive feature of the new resource map: it can create leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around the architecture of mineral supply chains.
articles.abstract_cn: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生经济对象，其结构是市场势力的来源。利用 13 种电气化金属在 1995-2023 年间的双边贸易数据，我们表明这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料更为分散、多边的结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心性并非源于资源禀赋：中国拥有的底层储量很少。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定大宗商品的发展融资建立起来的，是一种均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们在一个程式化模型中形式化这一逻辑，其中一国选择自己要变得多中心，并表明中心性可以映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求和竞争性边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，关键矿产的世界价格对供给削减的反应更强。通过构建基于文本的、特定大宗商品的供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使欧盟和美国的消费者通胀上升幅度约为可比的化石燃料冲击的两倍，且更为持久。因此，中心性不仅仅是新资源地图的描述性特征：它可以创造对全球价格的影响力。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但围绕矿产供应链的架构将其重新构建。

articles.title_en: The Heterogeneous Effects of Entry on Prices
articles.title_cn: 进入对价格的异质性影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of entry on the price distribution in the German retail gasoline market. Exploiting several hundred entries over five years in an event study design, we find that entry causes a persistent first-order stochastic shift in the price distribution for at least three years after entry. Prices at the top of the distribution change moderately or not at all, but prices at the left tail decrease by up to 13% (9%) of stations’ gross margins after entry within a 1 km (2 km) radius. The value of information (VOI) increases by 29% (15%) in 1 km (2 km) markets, suggesting larger savings for consumers with easy access to information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了进入对德国零售汽油市场价格分布的影响。利用五年间数百次进入的事件研究设计，我们发现进入导致价格分布出现持续的一阶随机偏移，至少在进入后三年内如此。分布顶部的价格变化温和或没有变化，但分布左尾的价格在进入后，在1公里（2公里）半径内下降高达13%（9%）的加油站毛利率。信息价值（VOI）在1公里（2公里）市场中增加29%（15%），表明易于获取信息的消费者能节省更多。

articles.title_en: Communication and the Emergence of a Unidimensional World
articles.title_cn: 沟通与一维世界的出现
articles.abstract_en: While individuals hold, exchange, and update opinions over multiple issues, these opinions are often correlated, and a unidimensional spectrum is enough to summarize them. But when should one expect opinions to be unidimensional? And how important is the underlying structure of communication? Our experimental results validate the crisp predictions by DeMarzo, Vayanos, and Zwiebel (2003) when individuals update their opinions on a fixed network, always trusting the same neighbors, and confirm the importance of the communication structure in predicting whether individuals hold relatively moderate or extreme opinions. We also provide a theoretical result, simulation results, and experimental evidence suggesting that unidimensionality may arise even when individuals’ networks vary over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然个体会就多个议题持有、交换并更新观点，但这些观点往往相互关联，一个一维谱系就足以概括它们。但人们何时应预期观点是一维的？沟通的底层结构又有多重要？我们的实验结果验证了DeMarzo、Vayanos和Zwiebel（2003）在个体于固定网络上更新观点、始终信任相同邻居时所作的清晰预测，并证实了沟通结构在预测个体持有相对温和还是极端观点方面的重要性。我们还提供了一个理论结果、模拟结果和实验证据，表明即使个体的网络随时间变化，一维性也可能出现。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies conscription’s role in durably shaping attitudes and beliefs consistent with nation-building. We pair original survey data covering 29 cohorts of conscripts in Argentina with random variation in service emerging from a lottery. We find that serving in the military leads to a stronger national identity and social integration several decades after serving but does not affect civic behaviors such as voting or paying taxes. Value inculcation during service helps explain the baseline patterns, while exposure to and interaction with diverse peers reinforce but do not drive the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究征兵在持久塑造与nation-building相一致的态度和信念方面的作用。我们将覆盖阿根廷29个应征入伍者队列的原始调查数据与来自抽签的服役随机变异相结合。我们发现，服兵役会在服役数十年后带来更强的国家认同和社会融合，但不会影响投票或纳税等公民行为。服役期间的价值灌输有助于解释基线模式，而与多元化同伴的接触和互动会强化但不会驱动这些结果。

articles.abstract_en: We provide a nonanthropocentric rationale for implementing a levy on meat consumption due to animal-welfare considerations. It operates as a Pigouvian tax and addresses externalities on farmed animals. Under total utilitarianism, the levy is a subsidy when an animal’s life is worth living, and a tax when it is not. The levy varies under alternative normative settings, illustrating the importance of population-ethics issues for the pricing of externalities in this context. Even under conservative assumptions, calibrated tax levels are substantial and would make most intensive animal farms unprofitable. Taxes are significantly higher for chickens and pigs than for cows, in contrast to the taxation of other meat externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于动物福利考量，为对肉类消费征税提供了非人类中心主义的理由。该税作为庇古税运作，并处理养殖动物所承受的外部性。在总体功利主义下，当动物的生命值得过时，该税是一种补贴；当其生命不值得过时，则是一种税。该税在替代性规范设定下会有所不同，说明了人口伦理问题在此情境下对外部性定价的重要性。即使在保守假设下，校准后的税率也相当可观，将使大多数集约化动物农场无利可图。与对其他肉类外部性征税相比，对鸡和猪的税率显著高于对牛的税率。

articles.title_en: Sovereign Default Risk and Firm Heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 主权违约风险与企业异质性
articles.abstract_en: This paper measures the output costs of sovereign risk by combining a sovereign debt model with firm- and bank-level data. An increase in sovereign risk lowers the price of government debt and has an adverse impact on banks’ balance sheets, disrupting their ability to finance firms. The resulting fall in credit supply impacts firms directly, as they need to borrow at higher interest rates, and indirectly through general equilibrium effects on the price of inputs and other goods. Importantly, firms are not equally affected by these developments: Those that have greater financing needs and that borrow from banks that hold more government debt are mostly affected by the change in borrowing rates, while firms that do not borrow are only impacted indirectly. We show that these direct and indirect effects can be recovered using a firm-level regression, which we estimate using Italian data. We calibrate our model to match the measured firm-level elasticities and find that heightened sovereign risk was responsible for one-third of the observed output decline during the Italian debt crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过将主权债务模型与企业层面和银行层面的数据相结合，衡量了主权风险的产出成本。主权风险上升会降低政府债务价格，并对银行的资产负债表产生不利影响，扰乱其为企业融资的能力。由此导致的信贷供给下降直接影响企业，因为它们需要以更高的利率借款，并通过一般均衡效应对投入品和其他商品的价格产生间接影响。重要的是，企业受这些变化的影响并不相同：那些融资需求更大、且从持有更多政府债务的银行借款的企业，主要受到借款利率变化的影响，而不借款的企业仅受到间接影响。我们表明，这些直接和间接效应可以通过企业层面的回归来识别，我们使用意大利数据进行了估计。我们将模型校准以匹配所测得的企层面弹性，并发现主权风险加剧对意大利债务危机期间观察到的产出下降负有三分之一的責任。

articles.title_en: The Role of Information in Collective Decisions
articles.title_cn: 信息在集体决策中的作用
articles.abstract_en: We study how members of a group vote for public information. We argue, both theoretically and experimentally, that voters are more likely to vote for information to be acquired relative to their own individual willingness to pay for information when ex-ante disagreement is higher and ex-post disagreement is lower. Ex-ante and ex-post disagreement refer to the disagreement among group members over the best policy for the group to follow before and after information is acquired, respectively. We discuss how the results inform the debate over the role of the State in fostering progress, and the value of the wisdom of the crowd.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究群体成员如何投票决定是否获取公共信息。我们从理论和实验两方面论证，当事前分歧较高且事后分歧较低时，选民相对于其自身对信息的个人支付意愿，更有可能投票支持获取信息。事前分歧和事后分歧分别指在获取信息之前和之后，群体成员之间就群体应遵循的最佳政策所存在的分歧。我们讨论这些结果如何为关于国家在促进进步中的作用的辩论，以及群体智慧的价值提供启示。

articles.title_en: Innovation Union: Costs and Benefits of Innovation Policy Coordination
articles.title_cn: 创新联盟：创新政策协调的成本与收益
articles.abstract_en: What is the scope for international cooperation in innovation policy in economies closely integrated via trade? We address this question by building a two-region innovation-driven growth model with endogenous technology diffusion via foreign direct investment (FDI). We use the model to analyse R&D subsidy cooperation in the EU, which has a common trade and monetary policy but where a coordinated innovation policy is still in its infancy. Stark differences in innovation capabilities between the West (old member states) and the East (new member states) shape optimal policies. Western countries have higher R&D efficiency and serve as primary sources of knowledge spillovers, through FDI-driven technology transfer. Cooperation is driven by two factors: correcting distortions from subsidy competition, the strategic motive, and leveraging intertemporal knowledge spillovers that sustain growth. A coordinated policy involves substantial subsidies for the West and taxes for the East, reflecting the West’s superior R&D efficiency and role as a key source of knowledge spillovers. Both regions experience welfare gains, primarily by internalising cross-border spillovers. We find strong complementarity between innovation and FDI subsidies, showing that jointly supporting knowledge creation and diffusion yields greater benefits than implementing each policy in isolation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在通过贸易紧密一体化的经济体中，创新政策国际合作的适用范围是什么？我们通过构建一个两区域创新驱动增长模型来回答这个问题，该模型包含通过外国直接投资（FDI）实现的内生技术扩散。我们使用该模型分析欧盟的研发补贴合作，欧盟拥有共同的贸易和货币政策，但协调的创新政策仍处于起步阶段。西方（老成员国）与东方（新成员国）在创新能力上的显著差异塑造了最优政策。西方国家具有更高的研发效率，并通过FDI驱动的技术转移成为知识溢出的主要来源。合作由两个因素驱动：纠正补贴竞争造成的扭曲，即战略动机，以及利用维持增长的跨期知识溢出。协调政策包括对西方提供大量补贴、对东方征税，这反映了西方优越的研发效率以及作为知识溢出关键来源的角色。两个地区都获得福利收益，主要是通过内部化跨境溢出。我们发现创新补贴与FDI补贴之间存在强互补性，表明联合支持知识创造与扩散比单独实施各项政策能带来更大收益。

articles.title_en: Democracy, Redistribution, and Inequality: Evidence from the English Poor Law
articles.title_cn: 民主、再分配与不平等：来自英国济贫法的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests whether inequality shapes the redistributive impact of democratization by examining changes to the governance of councils providing poor relief—rudimentary social insurance—in 19th-century Britain. An 1894 reform removed institutional features—a graduated franchise, property qualifications, the absence of a secret ballot, and the participation of unelected magistrates—that allowed landowners to control spending on poor relief after the 1832 Great Reform Act. The empirical analysis uses a new annual dataset of poor law spending from 1884 to 1905 to test whether higher pre-reform inequality amplified the effect of democratic reform on redistribution. The results support the Meltzer–Richard hypothesis: higher local income inequality led to higher poor relief spending after 1894. Areas where landed elites held political power saw smaller increases in expenditure, indicating that de facto elite influence muted the effect of democratization. These findings provide empirical support for models of democratization that focus on demands for redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察19世纪英国提供济贫——一种基本社会保险——的议会治理变化，检验不平等是否塑造了民主化的再分配效应。1894年的一项改革移除了制度特征——累进选举权、财产资格、无记名投票的缺失以及未经选举的治安法官的参与——这些特征使得土地所有者在1832年《大改革法案》之后能够控制济贫支出。实证分析使用1884年至1905年济贫支出的新年度数据集，检验改革前更高的不平等是否放大了民主改革对再分配的影响。结果支持Meltzer–Richard假说：地方收入不平等越高，1894年后的济贫支出越高。土地精英掌握政治权力的地区支出增长较小，表明事实上的精英影响力削弱了民主化的效应。这些发现为关注再分配需求的民主化模型提供了实证支持。

articles.title_en: What Drives Overstay? The Case of Afghan Asylum Seekers in Germany
articles.title_cn: 什么驱动了逾期滞留？德国阿富汗寻求庇护者的案例
articles.abstract_en: The paper is structured around three main contributions. First, it takes advantage of a unique survey on Afghan asylum seekers in Germany to provide novel descriptive insights into asylum seekers’ beliefs about their outcomes and the associated intention to overstay. Second, it estimates asylum seekers’ perceived ex ante returns on overstaying and option values of regularisation, deportation, and experimentation. Third, it assesses and rejects the cost-effectiveness argument for assisted voluntary return policies. Instead, it estimates a sizeable willingness-to-pay of asylum seekers for investments that would guarantee their regularisation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文围绕三个主要贡献展开。第一，利用一项关于德国阿富汗寻求庇护者的独特调查，提供了关于寻求庇护者对其结果的信念以及相关逾期滞留意图的新颖描述性见解。第二，估计了寻求庇护者对逾期滞留的感知事前回报以及正规化、驱逐和试验的期权价值。第三，评估并拒绝了协助自愿返回政策的成本效益论点。相反，它估计了寻求庇护者为保证其正规化的投资所愿意支付的可观金额。
